## ResolvableParentContainment interface

The `container` of resolvable reference data to a resource found only within an object of `Parent`<!-- -->: required, and an identity reference to that object, as data whose own container follows its resource's rule, or as a reference a client bound.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface ResolvableParentContainment<Resources extends ResourceTable, Parent extends string>
```
